name: Exp_BykovTrend_ReOpen
summary: This EA implements the BykovTrend trend-following indicator signal to open positions, with a ReOpen feature that allows adding to existing positions when the trend signal persists. It trades in the direction of the detected trend and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BykovTrend趋势指标信号开仓，并具有加仓（ReOpen）功能，当趋势信号持续时可以在同方向追加仓位。它沿着检测到的趋势方向交易，并通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于BykovTrend指标进行趋势跟踪交易，该指标通过价格动量和趋势方向变化来产生买卖信号。入场条件为BykovTrend指标发出趋势方向信号——买入信号出现时做多，卖出信号出现时做空。ReOpen功能是该EA的核心特色，允许在趋势持续时对已有仓位进行同方向加仓，从而放大趋势行情中的收益。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，并通过ReOpen参数控制加仓的次数和间距，但没有看到明确的马丁格尔或网格机制。资金管理依赖止损和止盈设置，但加仓行为可能导致持仓集中度过高。出场条件包括止盈/止损触发以及反向信号出现时平仓，但加仓后的整体风险敞口管理需要特别注意。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the BykovTrend indicator, which generates buy/sell signals through price momentum and trend direction changes. Entry conditions are triggered when the BykovTrend indicator issues a directional signal — long positions on buy signals and short positions on sell signals. The ReOpen feature is the EA's core characteristic, allowing additional positions to be opened in the same direction when the trend persists, amplifying profits during strong trending moves. Position sizing uses fixed lots with configurable ReOpen parameters controlling the number and spacing of additional entries, without explicit martingale or grid mechanisms. Money management relies on stop loss and take profit settings, but the ReOpen behavior can lead to concentrated position exposure. Exit conditions include TP/SL triggers and position closure on reverse signals, though overall risk exposure management after multiple re-entries requires careful attention.

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，顺势交易胜率相对较高
ReOpen加仓机制在强趋势行情中可以显著放大收益
参数化设计灵活，用户可自定义止损止盈和加仓规则
使用MagicNumber区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic with relatively high win rate in trending markets
ReOpen mechanism can significantly amplify profits during strong trend moves
Flexible parameterized design allowing customization of SL/TP and re-entry rules
Uses MagicNumber for order identification, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
cons: 加仓机制可能导致趋势反转时亏损放大，风险集中度过高
默认止损止盈为0，若不手动设置则无风险保护
缺乏加仓间距控制，可能在不合适的价位密集加仓
未包含新K线检测机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下信号质量下降
cons_en: ReOpen mechanism can amplify losses during trend reversals with concentrated risk exposure
Default SL/TP values are 0, providing no risk protection unless manually configured
Lacks spacing control for re-entries, potentially adding positions at unfavorable prices
No new bar check mechanism, risking duplicate entries on the same candle
No spread filter, signal quality degrades in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加加仓间距控制（如至少间隔N根K线或N点才能加仓），避免密集加仓
添加新K线检测和点差过滤，提高信号质量和交易安全性
实现整体仓位的风险管理，如最大总持仓手数或最大回撤限制
improvements_en: Add re-entry spacing control (e.g., minimum N bars or N pips between re-opens) to prevent clustered position accumulation
Implement new bar detection and spread filtering to improve signal quality and trading safety
Implement portfolio-level risk management such as maximum total lot size or maximum drawdown limits

risk_points: ReOpen加仓机制在趋势反转时可能导致较大回撤

缺乏新K线检测和加仓间距控制
risk_points_en: ReOpen mechanism can cause significant drawdown during trend reversals
Default SL/TP of 0 means no risk protection unless explicitly set
Lacks new bar check and re-entry spacing controls
